pro_course_detail.title: Pronunciation Class with homework
pro_course_detail.description:
This class is for all levels. It is never too early or too late to work on your pronunciation!

I have extensive experience with Spanish, Chinese, and Russian speakers. 
I have identified the main issues that these students have, and know how to fix them. We will target these sounds first, so that you can finally pronounce all of the sounds in English correctly. 

After we correct the pronunciation of sounds, we can move on to more complex issues such as connected speech and linking, so that you can sound confident and natural :) 

Your success will be determined by how much you PRACTICE! A teacher can show you how to pronounce sounds, but if you don't practice it, you won't change the way you speak.  You use dozens of different muscles in your body when you speak (you use your nose, face, throat and stomach too!) Muscles have to be exercised if you want results. 

Materials for this class:
- A Google document with homework and notes, and links to videos 
- A pronunciation book as a pdf

pro_course_detail.title: Intermediate or Advanced speaking practice through conversation
pro_course_detail.description:
(This is not a grammar class. If you want to focus on grammar, please choose that option :)
If you want homework assignments, writing practice/editing, or a study plan, please choose the grammar class.)

The point of this class to FOR YOU TO TALK!  If you cannot give long responses, I will teach you how :)

I want you to speak as much as possible, and I will patiently listen.  You can choose the topic at the beginning of the class, or we will naturally choose one together. This natural, unplanned kind of practice gives you practice thinking and speaking under a little bit of pressure, LIKE IN REAL LIFE. I plan topics in advance for my beginner students, but I think speaking spontaneously is more beneficial for intermediate  / advanced students. 

I will correct your grammar and pronunciation along the way. You will feel like you are talking with a friend, except this friend can help you with your English and answer any questions you may have. You will practice listening, learn new vocabulary and grammatical structures in the most natural way possible - conversation.

It it HIGHLY recommended to either take notes during the class, or to go back and paste our Skype notes into a Google doc or some other place. You need to review the corrections and practice them.

pro_course_detail.title: Beginners- start speaking :)
pro_course_detail.description:
This option is for beginners who *know some basic things* (so not absolute beginners,) but don't have confidence to speak. 

If your native language is Spanish, I will be able to speak to you, translate, and help you in Spanish if you need it. If your native language is Portuguese, I will be able to understand and translate most things into English...and give you answers in Spanish, which you will probably understand. 

Its best for you to be in control of your learning. We should talk about what YOU like. So if you can tell me a topic you want to practice, you will have a more useful class. 

One of my strengths as a teacher is making students, no matter how nervous, feel comfortable. I will patiently guide you through a conversation.  We will be relaxed, and you will finish the class with new vocabulary words and phrases.  I will write new words for you in the chat, and you should copy these down later either into a Google document or into a notebook. Learning is active, not passive. You should take notes after the class. But during the class, you can just focus on speaking.

pro_course_detail.title: Grammar with homework  (all levels)
pro_course_detail.description:
The problem with grammar classes in big institutes or schools is usually that you don't have the chance to practice what you have learned. In a private 1:1 class, that's half of what we do :)

I use a combination of infographics, pictures, videos, websites, books, podcasts, and even songs to help you REALLY, finally understand grammar.  

We will start by introducing the topic. I will tell you when and how we use it. We will do some examples. And then we'll start using it. 

Homework is an important part in making progress and REMEMBERING what you've learned. For grammar classes I give grammar exercises, but also videos, podcasts, or songs. We check the homework at the beginning of the next class. 

You won't need to take grammar classes forever! Once you've learned a few new concepts, I recommend taking some conversation classes to practice it in a real world like environment.

pro_course_detail.title: LISTENING- how to understand native speakers!
pro_course_detail.description:
I have really good news for you. You are not bad at listening, and native speakers don't speak ~fast.

There are patterns in our speech that you were never taught. *English does not sound the way it is writtten.* Spoken English is different from written English. 

I am sure that you are going to be surprised when I teach you how we really speak (for example, when you realize that  ' what did you' sounds like 'wuh jew.' )

You can definitely learn these patterns and decode native English with practice. 

I will teach you the rules and patterns of spoken US English so you can finally understand it. I will also introduce / explain some common dialects and accents within the United States (southern, black, Indian English, etc.) I can adjust my speech to sound as slow, or as natural / native as possible, so that I can give you explanations in a very clear way.

Materials for this class include a book that I will send you, a Google document where we will keep your homework, and Youtube videos. 

As with all of my classes, we can use Spanish at any time that you need or want to. :)

I'm very proud of this student's achievement, and all the others like it that I have enjoyed being a part of. Others have written similar results; most felt they could only have received the score they got due to my help and guidance. 
I try to make learning fun and engaging by using proven methods and techniques. We will have conversations on a variety of topics no matter the students' skills or confidence level. I provide a variety of useful resources, such as full curricula, to help guide students on their exciting learning journey.
teacher_info.teaching_style: I encourage students to choose topics they wish to discuss and I'll correct pronunciation and grammar as needed using proven techniques for remembering what they learn. Students are rewarded for self-correcting (HOORAY!) errors while I provide patient guidance, kindness and support. I find a touch of humor goes a long way. :-). No matter if it's the first lesson or ongoing packages, students will gain MUCH CONFIDENCE in their ability to hold all sorts of conversations with other English speakers without worrying about making mistakes. We will have you talking confidently today!!

exp_info.description: I taught ESL in several schools in Thailand from Kindergarten to year 13 for nearly 11 years. I have taught beginners and assisted in exam preparation courses for IELTS and Cambridge IGCSE. I have also taught Business English to adults privately from time to time. I have retained materials for all levels and all student needs and will provide structured lessons for all specific learning needs.

I taught small group classes of business professionals from several industries, such as hospital staff and mining industry workers, how to improve their communication skills as a part-time tutor. I also taught children one on one and small group classes whose ages ranged from 5 years to 14 years old, all levels and all aspects of English: reading, writing, listening, speaking, grammar and conversational English. Business groups received certificates of completion at the end of each course.

course_info.trial_description: This lesson will begin with basic topics of conversation, such as introductions and general information, and will gradually accellerate to more complex vocabulary and dialogues in order to adequately assess and place learners in the correct level course. This lesson is designed to allow the teacher to gauge students' levels of English and to help facilitate a good connection between student and teacher. Six years and up only please with some ability to understand/speak in English (does not have to be perfect or even correct, just has to be a little bit).

pro_course_detail.title: Introducing myself: Sowing the seeds for a continuing English learning journey. Beginner level (A1-A2)
pro_course_detail.description: This series of lessons is designed to assist beginners to practice speaking simple sentences and to enjoy basic conversations about themselves and the world around them.  Classes include fun activities, dialogues, audio and video lessons intended to encourage students to learn basic grammar points, vocabulary building, how to talk about themselves and the environment around them, ask and answer simple questions on specific topics using target language, working towards building an exciting journey forward as they learn the ways to master fluency. Materials are provided for teens (13 years and older ONLY PLEASE) and adults. One main focus is to help students overcome shyness about their abilities. I will help students feel comfortable and more confident in speaking about common day-to-day topics of conversation. Don't let being a "beginner" hold you back from having fun with the English language!

pro_course_detail.title: Lower/Upper Intermediate Conversation / comprehension (B1 / B2)
pro_course_detail.description:
Mid-level course will allow learners to understand factual information and show awareness of opinions, attitudes and mood in both spoken and written English. It can be used as proof of a student's ability to use English to communicate with native speakers for everyday purposes. Dialogues, videos, vocabulary building exercises and other materials are available and students are free to choose their preferred types of practice. 
The course offers learners the opportunity to develop practical communication skills and will enable learners to become independent users of English, and to be able to use English to communicate effectively in a variety of practical contexts. 
Course materials are for teens (13 years and up ONLY) and adults. This is a level whereby students already have a good grasp of the basics and want to hone their skills, getting errors corrected along the way, while acquiring more advanced grammar and vocabulary, as well as feeling comfortable holding longer conversations. This is a fun and engaging series of classes, learning while having a good time practicing.

pro_course_detail.title: Intermediate/Advanced level/speaking/listening test preparation (B1 - C1)
pro_course_detail.description:
In these higher level courses learners will explore and understand the following that may apply directly to IELTS, TOEFL, and other types of English exams:
Practical strategies to help learners achieve results in all areas of the exams - particularly speaking parts 1,2 and 3, listening and reading. Writing may be included at the students' request.
Students can hone their skills using past exam questions and topic prompts. Reading practice includes skimming and scanning, looking for key language within a text, inference, predicting what you will hear, repetition of answers, identifying synonyms and other ways of analysing a text. 
Learn how the exams are assessed and get tips on how to deal with common problems learners have while preparing.  
A series of classes is recommended to make the most of your preparation time and to perfect your skills.

pro_course_detail.title: Professional / Business Conversation - Upper Intermediate/Advanced (B1 - C2)
pro_course_detail.description: This course is geared toward adults seeking to hone their communication skills related to business vocabulary, presentation language and other professional areas of communication. Dialogues, general comprehension and grammar, reading and listening, and vocabulary building specific to students' needs are provided for continual practice along with any other areas where a student needs guidance. This course includes any or all of the following: Drafting email messages, preparing/finalizing presentations, job interviews, company descriptions, common (business and casual) idioms, and other topics tailored to students' needs. A general overview of business language will be incorporated until such time as the student requests industry specific resources to be used in class. Some materials provided to the student upon request. Self-study and self-correction of errors are encouraged but not necessary.

pro_course_detail.title: Intermediate/Advanced Conversation for small groups - Teens 16+ and adults ONLY
pro_course_detail.description: Price is PER PERSON!!!  Interractive conversations for small group classes for teens (16+) and adults. Interesting and thought provoking topics, grammar and vocab lessons and corrections, fairly given talk time for each student in turn. Self-correction and student interraction is encouraged. Meet new people, make new friends, have fun practicing your English speaking and listening skills that you can use anywhere in the world. I am patient, knowledgeable, and enjoy making my classes FUN - a sense of humor is highly encouraged. :-) Reach out to me via text message (here) with any specific topics your group may be interested in or any other concerns. See you soon in class!

pro_course_detail.title: NEW LESSONS FOR 6 - 12 y/o KIDS! Develop the 4 skills: read,write,listen,speak + add vocab
pro_course_detail.description: Beginningers welcome but MUST HAVE SOME ability to communicate in English. No ABCs / absolute beginners please. We will develop reading, writing, listening and speaking, adding grammar points and vocabulary along the way (Note: HOMEWORK once a week UPON REQUEST ONLY), starting with phonics and basic pronunciation if needed. Skills increase in difficulty, working up through more challenging grammar and vocabulary. Choose your adventures with Oxford Phonix, Oxford Discover, Oxford Reading Tree (ORT), Reach Higher, Reading Explorer, Wonders, Magic Tree House and other great books. Learning plans will be based on initial level assessment and recommendations for the appropriate curriculum. Boost your child's learning for school and exams. Interactive materials, audio and video and **GAMES are included.**. These are fun and exciting! Sorry but I'm not accepting students under 6 years. Please specify the AGE of your child and LEVEL (if known) when booking. English nicknames are preferred. Many after school slots available. :-) See you in class!

**Lessons cannot be canceled or rescheduled within 24 hours of the lesson start time. You will still be charged for the lesson even if you do not attend the class.
